findings.what: The brief's binding 'Orchestrator decisions' section is explicit: "messages/en.json: extend ClientKnowledge (:2527) and ArApCounterparty (:3815) — the four counterparty recordedVia.* strings under ArApCounterparty, any new sourceKind.* key under ClientKnowledge; no third namespace." DECISIONS.md restates the same rule for #647 ("do not mint a third namespace (shared file — keep the edit localised)"). The branch adds a brand-new top-level namespace `"ClientIdentifiers": { ... }` (sibling of `ArApCounterparty` and `ClientKnowledge`) and wires H-20's client-identifier section/dialog strings through it instead of nesting them under `ArApCounterparty`.
findings.evidence: `grep -n '^  "ArApCounterparty"\|^  "ClientIdentifiers"\|^  "ClientKnowledge"' apps/web/messages/en.json` -> 2530:ClientKnowledge, 3819:ArApCounterparty, 4035:ClientIdentifiers — three siblings at the same 2-space top-level indent, not two. `grep -rn 'useTranslations("ClientIdentifiers' apps/web/components/registers/*.tsx` -> AddClientIdentifierDialog.tsx:38, client-identity-section.tsx:54 confirm it is a live, wired namespace.
findings.fix: Fold `ClientIdentifiers.*` under `ArApCounterparty` (e.g. `ArApCounterparty.clientIdentifiers.*`) as the brief and DECISIONS.md require, and update the two `useTranslations` call sites accordingly.

findings.what: A new `sourceKind.counterparty_alias` string ("Recorded on a counterparty alias") was added under `ClientKnowledge`, but every call site that renders an identity alias's source (`counterparty-identity-panel.tsx:130`) passes only `"document_extraction"` or `"user_statement"` — both pre-existing keys — into `KnowledgeSourceBlock`. `knowledge-shared.tsx:142` is the only place that interpolates `sourceKind.${sourceKind}`, and nothing in the diff ever resolves to `counterparty_alias`, so the string is unreachable dead i18n content. `pnpm lint`'s `check-message-keys` only flags missing keys, not unused ones, so it did not catch this.
findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'sourceKind\.' apps/web --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts | grep -v test` -> only two hits: `counterparty-identity-panel.tsx:126` (a comment) and `knowledge-shared.tsx:142` (`t(\`sourceKind.${sourceKind}\`)`); `counterparty-identity-panel.tsx:130` sets `sourceKind={alias.source.extraction_id ? "document_extraction" : "user_statement"}` — `counterparty_alias` is never assigned anywhere in the diff.
findings.fix: Either wire a call site that actually needs this source-kind, or delete the unused `sourceKind.counterparty_alias` key.
